experiment: E41 supervised attack detector trained inside each fit fold
motivation: E40 showed that attack-aware rejection works but its unsupervised max_cosine detector saturates at AUROC 0.9008 (targeted PGD only 0.76-0.85), capping macro ASafeR at 0.7082. A detector trained on fit-fold clean plus fit-fold adversarial trials should separate the two distributions almost perfectly, because at training time the labels 'clean vs perturbed' are known by construction and are not identity labels.
legality: the detector is trained only on the fit split of the same fold; attacks for detector training are generated against the same fold's frozen identity model. The inner validation known block, pseudo-unknown subjects, outer folds and Test are never used for detector training. Attack labels used for detector training are generated labels, not Test or outer labels.

data.source: Train session1 only; read-only reuse of the E36 feature cache and Train MAT files

identity_model: frozen E36 detrend_zband_cov5_wccn_prototype, identical to E36C and E40

detector.train_negatives: clean fit-split trials, E36 stratified first 8 per identity/task
detector.train_positives: the same trials attacked with untargeted FGSM SNR30, untargeted PGD SNR30, untargeted PGD SNR20, targeted PGD SNR30, targeted PGD SNR20 (5 generators, PGD20 steps, target = next registered identity in sorted order)
detector.feature_note: all eight are label-free functions of one trial; the first four come from the frozen prototype scores, the next two from the frozen whitened feature, the last two from the raw spectrum
detector.score: logistic decision_function, higher means more attack-like

decision_rule.threshold_solving: shared lower quantile q over 200 evenly spaced values in [0.001, 0.05] on the inner clean-known validation block: t_dr = quantile(distance_ratio, q) and t_det = quantile(detector, 1-q); choose q whose joint clean-known acceptance is closest to 0.95
decision_rule.rationale: keeps the 95% acceptance budget fixed so C and U stay comparable to E36C and E40; solving only on clean validation data means the attack detector never sees the evaluation attacks

ablations.confidence_only: accept iff distance_ratio >= its own inner clean-known q05
ablations.e40_two_gate: accept iff distance_ratio >= t_dr and max_cosine >= t_mc with the E40 shared-quantile solve

evaluation.inner_folds: E36 five outer groups x two inner folds, identical seeds and continuous trial blocks
evaluation.subset: E36 stratified first 8 trials per identity/task for clean known and pseudo-unknown, identical to E36C and E40
evaluation.aggregation: per inner run in its own enrolled label space, averaged over the two inner runs, then averaged over five outer folds
evaluation.detector_audit: AUROC and best F1 of the supervised detector on the evaluation attacks versus clean known; reported per attack and as macro, never used to tune thresholds

targets.success: macro ASafeR and macro Score both strictly above E40 two_gate (0.7082 / 59.14) and above the E36C outer reference (0.6818 / 59.78), with C>=0.95, U>=0.95
targets.RA_note: macro RA>=0.95 remains unreachable at SNR20 and is not claimed

reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only inner nesting, pseudo-unknown subjects, E36 continuous file-block proxy, evaluation subset overlapping the fit split exactly as in E36C; detector training uses generated attack labels. No outer, no Test, no cross-session claim.
